title: Wash it All Away
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Wakana Kinme has run a laundry and cleaning shop in the seaside resort town of Atami for two years, with no memory of her own past (Square Enix blurb). Her careful cleaning protects the memories her customers attach to their belongings, and she builds friendships with locals (AniList, MangaUpdates). Tagged as a slow-paced slice of life with a subtle romance.
life_message: A quiet life of skilled, careful work and kindness to neighbors gives meaning even without knowing one's past.
